title: 完整人工智能培训课程仓库
summary: 该仓库包含Prof. Fernando Amaral的完整人工智能培训课程，涵盖机器学习、深度学习、大语言模型、生成式AI、NLP、智能体、计算机视觉、异常检测、遗传算法、模糊逻辑等。提供Python实践、项目和笔记本。
summary_en: Repository for the Complete Artificial Intelligence Training by Prof. Fernando Amaral, covering ML, DL, LLMs, GenAI, NLP, Agents, CV, anomaly detection, genetic algorithms, fuzzy logic, etc. Includes hands-on Python projects and notebooks.
